tests.id: validator.test.ts > validateWorld scene characters > reports unknown scene character id with a path tag

tests.scenario: Given a scene in validScene (id 'bedroom') with a character 'ghost' absent from the world list, When validateWorld runs, Then the errors contain 'scenes[bedroom].characters[0].id: unknown character ghost'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'unknown scene character' --testTimeout=10000

tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/validator.test.ts -t 'all in the world list' --testTimeout=10000
